client_alerts.headline: Resold Claude access is circulating through proxy services — check where client AI tokens actually come from
client_alerts.body: The Information reports (Oct 5) that token resellers in China are acquiring Claude accounts with accumulated identities and crypto-funded payment cards, then reselling access through proxy services. Any client buying discounted model access from a third-party gateway instead of the provider or an authorized cloud marketplace is sending prompts through an intermediary with no contract, no data-handling terms and no continuity guarantee. Ask clients to confirm every AI API key traces back to a direct or authorized-reseller agreement.

client_alerts.headline: Microsoft 365: advanced agent / MCP package uploads become default-on October 25
client_alerts.body: Unless an admin sets a policy first, users will be able to upload agent and MCP server packages from October 25. Clients on Microsoft 365 Copilot should choose all users, no users or specific groups in the Microsoft 365 admin center before that date, and treat it as a change-control item.

top_moves.title: Gemini 4 Argon moves through staged rollout as Google tightens consumer tiers on Oct 9
top_moves.body: Gemini 4 Argon is reported at **$2/$10 per million tokens** introductory pricing with a 1M-token output ceiling, going to cyber-defence partners first and paid API customers after. Separately, one roundup reports free Gemini users will be limited to 3.5 Flash-Lite from **October 9** and Plus users to 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.6 Flash — single-source, so verify before relying on it.

top_moves.title: Gray market for Claude accounts exposed: resold access routed through proxies
top_moves.body: The Information reports Chinese token resellers are building up Claude accounts with accumulated identities and crypto-funded cards and reselling them via proxy services. For clients this is a supplier-provenance problem: cheap third-party model gateways carry no data terms and can be cut off without notice.

top_moves.title: Microsoft sets an Oct 25 deadline: agent and MCP package uploads turn on by default
top_moves.body: Advanced package uploads become default-enabled on **October 25** unless admins choose a policy first. Copilot Cowork, Code, Autopilot and the newer SharePoint features are also moving to usage-based **Copilot Credits** between October and December.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: No product release today; Altman says the world should accept some bad outcomes for AI's benefits while an insider criticises OpenAI's safety culture.
providers.detail: No new ChatGPT or API release since Oct 2 (Finances for Free/Go, Codex 0.160.0). Sam Altman said on Oct 4 that the world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of the technology, and separately called treating AI as a religious force a real safety issue. An OpenAI insider's critique of the company's safety culture is circulating today. Reminder: gpt-5.1, gpt-5.3-codex and gpt-5.4-nano shut down April 1, 2027.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: Resold Claude accounts are being routed through proxy services in China; IPO roadshow meetings reportedly start as early as Oct 14.
providers.detail: The Information reports a gray market in Claude accounts built on accumulated identities and crypto-funded cards. Anthropic will book more than $660M in non-cash expense for employee charity matching, and reporting puts IPO roadshow meetings from Oct 14 with formal marketing the week of Nov 9. No new model or Claude Code release since 2.1.289 on Oct 4.
providers.alertReason: Resold Claude access via unauthorised proxy gateways — verify client token provenance

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Gemini 4 Argon is in staged rollout at a reported $2/$10 per million tokens, and consumer free and Plus tiers are reportedly restricted to Flash models from Oct 9.
providers.detail: Gemini 4 Argon (unveiled around Sept 30) goes to trusted cybersecurity partners and the US government first, then paid API customers; it is reported with a 1M-token output ceiling. One roundup says free users drop to 3.5 Flash-Lite and Plus users to 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.6 Flash from Oct 9 — not yet confirmed by a Google source. In Workspace, Skills are replacing Gems and Vids voiceovers move to Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: No new release; Grok 4.7 remains current and grok-voice-transcribe-1.0 reached end of life on Oct 2.
providers.detail: Nothing new in the last 48 hours. Requests to the retired transcribe model now route to grok-voice-transcribe-2.0 at the same price. Grok 5 still has no committed date.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Meta publishes six mathematics papers produced with Muse Spark in Thinking Mode, five resolving open problems.
providers.detail: The papers are co-authored with human mathematicians and include a disproof of Kida's 2024 conjecture. This is a research-capability signal, not a product change: Muse Spark 1.3 remains closed-weights with no confirmed EU availability, and there is still no Llama 5 date.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: No new release; the enterprise migration to the simplified Vibe experience that opened Oct 1 continues.
providers.detail: Admins choose when to migrate within a roughly six-month window. No new model in the last 48 hours.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: No new headline; the HP ZBook Ultra G3a Windows pre-install is still due this month.
providers.detail: Effort Mode and Deep Research inside Computer remain the latest features. No dated release in the last 48 hours.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Agent and MCP package uploads become default-on Oct 25, and advanced Copilot features move to usage-based Copilot Credits through December.
providers.detail: Admins must pick all users, no users or specific groups for advanced package uploads before Oct 25. Copilot Cowork, Code, Autopilot and newer SharePoint features shift to Copilot Credits between October and December. The Copilot entry in the Teams chat list is being removed mid-to-late October, and PowerPoint Copilot can now finish long tasks in the background.
providers.alertReason: Default-on agent/MCP uploads Oct 25 — admin decision required

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: No new release since Copilot CLI 1.0.91 on Oct 1 (Windows sandbox and certificate management).
providers.detail: CLI 1.0.89 added support for Claude Code rule files. Nothing dated in the last 48 hours.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: No new headline; no dated Cursor release found in the last 48 hours.
providers.detail: Cursor 3's Agents Window and Background Agents remain the current feature set.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: No release since June 12; the extended quiet stretch continues.
providers.detail: The only recent change on record is an August mobile stability update.

providers.name: Notion AI

providers.detail: Workers are reported at roughly $0.0023 per run from Oct 15. A Sept 30 change adds a SIEM event when admins alter the AI meeting-notes consent setting — useful audit evidence.
